Title: Azure Arc for Servers in Public Preview

Body.Content:
Hundreds of millions of Azure resources are organized, governed, and secured daily by customers using Azure Resource Manager. Azure Resource Manager is the control plane in Azure that provides robust deployment, management, and governance capabilities with Azure Shell, Azure Portal, API, role-based access control (RBAC) and Azure Policy for all Azure resources. 

Azure Arc enables a range of customer benefits, including:

  • Asset organization and inventory of Windows and Linux Servers, Kubernetes clusters and Azure services with a unified view in the Azure Portal and API
  • Universal governance of customer resources through Azure Policy
  • Standardized role-based access control (RBAC) across systems and different types of resources
  • Enable application owners to apply and audit their applications to meet compliance requirements
  • Ability to measure and remediate compliance at scale and down to the individual application, server, or cluster

Visit the Azure Arc webpage and Docs page, and ready Julia White’s Ignite Day 1 blog to learn more.
